```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        if pd.isna(value):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(float(value), 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw and lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", round((tw - lw) / lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly and ly != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", round((tw - ly) / ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")

    rev = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)

    # Top 5 entities by revenue this week (+ share for top 3)
    for i, (_, r) in enumerate(rev.head(5).iterrows()):
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for this product")
        if i < 3:
            sh = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")) else (
                r["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan)
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", round(float(sh), 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # Concentration: top 5 share of total
    if tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", round(rev.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # Biggest WoW absolute movers
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
        if r["abs_wow"] > 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(3).iterrows():
        if r["abs_wow"] < 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # Biggest WoW percent movers among material products (above median TW revenue)
    med = rev["Revenue_TW"].median() if len(rev) else 0
    p = d[(d["Revenue_TW"] >= med) & d["WoW_Pct"].notna()]
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(float(r["WoW_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(float(r["WoW_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # Biggest YoY movers (absolute and percent)
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    y["abs_yoy"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
    for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        if r["abs_yoy"] > 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy").head(2).iterrows():
        if r["abs_yoy"] < 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    yp = y[(y["Revenue_TW"] >= med) & y["YoY_Pct"].notna()]
    for _, r in yp.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(1).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(float(r["YoY_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # Volume leader
    u = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"]).sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(u):
        add(u.iloc[0]["Entity"], "units", "TW", u.iloc[0]["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")
    o = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"]).sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(o):
        add(o.iloc[0]["Entity"], "orders", "TW", o.iloc[0]["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


main()
```
